title: Pentaho Developer - AI Speciality
description: AI-augmented data pipelines with Pentaho Data Integration. GenAI fundamentals, LLM integration patterns, structured extraction, and agent-as-a-service.

moduleSummaries.title: PDI AI Pipelines
moduleSummaries.summary: Key concepts behind LLM-powered pipelines — prompts, tokenization, embedding, semantic search, and transformer architecture. Foundational reading before the hands-on workshops.

moduleSummaries.title: GenAI
moduleSummaries.summary: GenAI fundamentals for data engineers — HTML parsing, Base64 encoding, AI Chat with RAG, prompt engineering, and real-world use cases like log analysis and sentiment classification.

moduleSummaries.title: LLM Integration
moduleSummaries.summary: PDI as the orchestration layer with a locally-hosted LLM via Ollama. Sentiment analysis, data quality, enrichment, named entity recognition, summarisation, and multi-staged pipelines.

moduleSummaries.title: LangExtract
moduleSummaries.summary: Turn free-form text into structured rows when regex is too brittle. Support tickets, clinical notes, and contract documents — extracted via a lightweight REST service backed by Ollama.

moduleSummaries.title: Agent-as-a-Service
moduleSummaries.summary: Move beyond direct LLM calls to genuine AI agents that reason over intermediate output. Deploy a Python agent that PDI orchestrates for cross-text pattern recognition no ETL step can replicate.
